description: The packaged (beta) build's permissions (BETA item 2). The sidecar is PyInstaller one-dir, shipped as a resource under sidecar/ and spawned through $RESOURCE, which the shell plugin resolves (tauri-plugin-shell 2.3.5, scope.rs): no machine path appears here. Two entries because the executable's name differs by OS. The one argument allowed is `--app`, which tells the frozen sidecar the app launched it (the live-database guard, BETA-PUB). tauri.beta.conf.json enables only this capability; the dev run keeps default.json.
